audio_languages.description: Subset of target_languages to also dub (audio deliverables). English is typically required.

voice_clone.description: Clone the source speaker's voice. Requires recorded consent in the rights record; default false (neutral voice).

join_clips.description: When a selection is set: true concatenates the selected windows (in listed order) into one output; false emits each window as a separate deliverable clip. Default true. Ignored when selection is null (whole video).

selection.description: Which parts of the source video to process. null/absent = whole video (single implicit segment).

windows.description: Ordered source-time windows to transform. Output order is list order (out-of-source-order allowed = re-sequencing).

id.description: Optional human-stable window id (referenced in reports/filenames). Auto-assigned when absent.

start.description: Window start as an HH:MM:SS(.mmm) / MM:SS string, or a (fractional) number of seconds.

exact.description: Per-window override: true cuts at the exact requested timecodes, bypassing snapping for THIS window. Overrides selection.snap_edges.

snap_edges.description: Project default: snap each window edge to the nearest cue/silence boundary in the full-source transcript. false = cut verbatim. Per-window exact overrides this. Default true.

snap_search_window_ms.description: Max distance (ms) a window edge may move to reach a snap candidate. No boundary within this radius = left at the requested timecode, reported as unsnapped. Default 2000.
